name: Tesseract inbox-triage DEV set v1
purpose: Development set for tuning the transparent triage rules in src/lib/engine/triage.ts. Written by the rules author. The blind TEST set (testset.json) was written by a different agent and is never inspected or used for tuning.

labels.po: Confirmed order that carries a PO number (PO, P.O., LPO, Purchase Order No.)
labels.pr: Intent to buy a specific product + quantity (quote accepted, please proceed, we'd like to order, PO to follow) but no PO number yet
labels.enquiry: Price / availability / spec / lead-time / quote-request questions with no commitment (a quantity may be mentioned hypothetically)
labels.followup: About an existing order, PO, delivery, invoice, backorder, return or credit note
labels.mdm: Asks to set up / extend / change a customer, vendor, item or cost-centre record

precedence: mdm > followup > po > pr > enquiry (used to break score ties; an explicit master-data request inside an order email is routed to MDM because the order cannot be booked until the record exists; a PO number inside a delivery/billing/amendment message is a reference to an existing order, so the message is a follow-up)
